transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we have a binding bid decision to make before Friday on a non-performing loan portfolio with a stated face balance of $12 million. Our preliminary internal worksheet has us at $8 million for the full stated portfolio. Before I can approve and submit our bid, I need sign-offs from credit risk, loan operations, and compliance as part of our routine pre-bid process. Let's walk through where things stand and what each of you needs to weigh in on.

The revised model also requires a cash reserve equal to exactly 25% of that bid. I haven't yet attached the updated model to the committee worksheet, but the $8 million figure currently on the worksheet would exceed our risk limit.

Operations has not yet updated the seller's tape to reflect this, so the preliminary worksheet and any bid calculations based on the full $12 million are overstating what we can actually acquire.
